breakdown.description: The re-entrant cutout faces are turned from natural boundaries into artificial clamps
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Keep the inner cutout boundaries traction-free (no displacement constraints and no applied traction),' which correctly matches the ground truth's instruction to 'keep the re-entrant inner boundaries traction-free.' The incomplete prompt's error of clamping the cutout faces (u=0 on the two cutout faces adjacent to the re-entrant corner) has been corrected — no Dirichlet boundary conditions are applied to the inner cutout boundaries.
